interventions.label: Offer co-regulation support
interventions.instructions: Move closer, reduce verbal load, and offer a calm co-regulation cue.

interventions.label: Reduce immediate task demands
interventions.instructions: Briefly reduce task complexity or pause the demand before re-engaging.

interventions.label: Repair shared attention
interventions.instructions: Re-enter the child’s focus with a simple shared-attention cue using an already salient object.
